traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Strelitziaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate; plants hermaphrodite; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous or woody; flowers in panicles; flowers zygomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule; stamens 5 to 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Strelitziaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 50, family Strelitziaceae: phyllotaxis pattern distichous, usually; read as {"distichous": "usually"}.

traits.bract_form.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 249, 251, 252, family Strelitziaceae: bract form spathe (large spathe-like bract under each cyme); read as "spathe".

traits.flowering_position.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 249, 251, 252, family Strelitziaceae: flowering position both (terminal or axillary); read as {"both": "often", "terminal": "often"}.

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 249, 251, 252, family Strelitziaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Strelitziaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
